member.name: M:AIGuiders.Platform.Execution.Documentation.Correspondence.WorkspaceForwardMap.MdLinkRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
\\[[^\\]]*\\]\\((?<target>[^)]+)\\)
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match '['.
○ Match a character other than ']' atomically any number of times.
○ Match the string "](".
○ "target" capture group.
○ Match a character other than ')' atomically at least once.
○ Match ')'.
